description: Authoritative S2 navigation core operational mode enum and transition conventions as specified in Architecture Revision 3.

INITIALIZING.description: Cold start, sensor calibration prior, or waiting for valid initial anchor fix.

GNSS_AIDED.description: Nominal operational mode where IMU dead-reckoning is aided by accepted GNSS updates.

DEGRADED.description: GNSS fix quality or innovation variance degraded; elevated filter uncertainty.

BLACKOUT_DR.description: GNSS absent or rejected; estimator operates in pure dead-reckoning.

REACQUIRING.description: Candidate GNSS fixes detected post-outage; undergoing dwell and innovation validation.

FAULT.description: Irrecoverable mathematical defect, PSD defect, or mandatory sensor halt.
